parameters.content:
## Sandbox onboarding review
Use n8n-nodes-sanctionskit@0.1.0 and select your own **sandbox** credential on both SanctionsKit nodes. Alex Morgan is invented. Coverage is fixed to sandbox@1. This template makes API requests only when you run it.

Potential matches require human review. No match is limited to selected coverage and never approves onboarding. No durable queue, webhook, retry, or customer update is configured. Production requires deliberate adaptation; see README.
